answer.explanation: Between 19:36 and 19:42Z the CrudApi function logged a continuous stream of AccessDeniedException errors on dynamodb:PutItem against CartTable (about 35-43 errors per minute). The live inline policy app-policy on CrudApiRole only allows dynamodb:GetItem and dynamodb:Query. The IaC template grants dynamodb:PutItem, GetItem and Query on the same table, so the deployed role has drifted from the intended state. The table ARN and TABLE_NAME match the IaC, and no commit in the window changed IAM, so the cause is the live role policy, not the code or the template. The thumbnailer OUTPUT_BUCKET commits (cf8a2c2 and its revert d36dd8f) fall outside this window and are unrelated to these errors.
